about_description:
BSM Logistics and Consulting has been operating in the international logistics industry since 2016.

The company has strong and proven experience in organizing freight transportation from China, Turkey, and European countries.
We place special emphasis on building logistics processes that are structured, transparent, and secure. From sourcing reliable manufacturers to freight collection, storage, consolidation, customs clearance, and final delivery — every stage is carried out under our full control.
By working with BSM, you can take your business to the next level. We are your reliable partner in freight transportation and logistics!

BSM — your trusted partner in international logistics!
